ApprovalConfig.description: An HTTP approval request before every update: a 2xx answer (or ok_statuses) approves unless its JSON body says "approved": false; a denial may name a retry time (Retry-After, retry_after_seconds). With approve_on: failure the answer is read the other way round.

approve_on.description: success (default): a 2xx answer (or ok_statuses) approves. failure: the url is a status URL, and its 2xx answer (or ok_statuses) denies while any other status, or an endpoint that cannot be reached, approves; the body's approved field, Retry-After and fail_open are ignored, a signing failure still denies.

fail_open.description: Approve when the endpoint cannot be reached (not recommended). No effect with approve_on: failure.

header_files.description: Headers whose values are read from files, read once at startup.

headers.description: Request headers, such as Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}.

label_allowlist.description: Container labels sent besides dockpaum.* and com.docker.compose.*; "*" sends all.

method.description: HTTP method. Default POST; GET, HEAD and DELETE send the request as query parameters.

ok_statuses.description: Status codes that approve instead of any 2xx.

recheck_before_stop.description: Ask again (phase final) after the pull and the pre-update hooks, right before the old container is stopped; a denial skips the update without stopping anything.

signing.description: Sign every approval request (X-Dockpaum-Signature, DOCKPAUM-APPROVAL-V1) with an HMAC-SHA256 key.

ApprovalSigning.description: The key approval requests are signed with.

key_id.description: Key ID sent in X-Dockpaum-Key-Id, so the approver can accept several keys during a rotation. Default default.

secret_file.description: File holding the HMAC secret (at least 32 bytes, surrounding whitespace trimmed), read again whenever it changes.

AuditConfig.description: The JSONL audit log of every update decision.

retention.description: How long records are kept. Default 31d.

exclude_regex.description: Never container names matching this RE2 regular expression.

include_regex.description: Only container names matching this RE2 regular expression.

include_stopped.description: Also consider containers that are not running; they are recreated without being started. DOCKPAUM_INCLUDE_STOPPED overrides it.

label_enable.description: Opt-in mode: only containers labelled dockpaum.enable=true (or Watchtower's enable label). DOCKPAUM_LABEL_ENABLE overrides it.

scope.description: Only containers labelled dockpaum.scope=<scope>. Unset: containers with a scope label are left to the instance that owns it. DOCKPAUM_SCOPE overrides it.

watchtower_labels.description: Honor com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.* labels; a dockpaum.* label wins. Default true.

addr.description: Listen address such as 127.0.0.1:8080; wins over port.

enabled.description: Serve the operational endpoints. Default true; false opens no port at all, and --healthcheck then reports healthy. DOCKPAUM_HTTP_ENABLED overrides it.

port.description: Listen port. Default 8080. DOCKPAUM_HTTP_PORT overrides it, also the port in addr.

read_token.description: Read-only bearer token for the /internal-api/ read routes (health, ready, busy, version, metrics, status, containers, summary) and /v1/metrics; it never triggers updates or checks and must differ from token. DOCKPAUM_HTTP_READ_TOKEN (or DOCKPAUM_HTTP_READ_TOKEN_FILE) overrides it.

read_token_file.description: File holding the read-only token, read once at startup.

token.description: Bearer token for every /internal-api/ route, health and readiness included, and for Watchtower's /v1/update and /v1/metrics; the update and check API accept only this token. Without token and read_token the read routes are open. Use ${VAR} or token_file; DOCKPAUM_HTTP_TOKEN (or DOCKPAUM_HTTP_TOKEN_FILE) overrides it.

token_file.description: File holding the token (a Docker or Kubernetes secret), read once at startup.

update_api.description: Enable POST /internal-api/v1/update (and GET or POST /v1/update with watchtower_compat) to queue a run on demand, and POST /internal-api/v1/check to queue a run that only checks and reports. Requires token. Default false. DOCKPAUM_HTTP_UPDATE_API overrides it.

watchtower_compat.description: Also serve Watchtower's HTTP API routes for its clients (dashboards such as Homepage, scripts): /v1/update (needs update_api and token) and /v1/metrics (authenticated like the /internal-api/ read routes). Default false.

HookConfig.description: Commands run around update runs and container updates: host commands, or exec:<container>:<command> inside a container (@self is the updated one).

disabled.description: Turn every hook off, label hooks included (not jobs).

label_hooks.description: Run commands from dockpaum.hook.* (and Watchtower lifecycle) container labels inside that container. Default false.

post_run.description: Host commands after every run whose pre_run succeeded.

pre_run.description: Host commands before every update run; a failure aborts the run.

pre_update.description: Before each container update; exit code 75 skips the update.

endpoint.description: Empty for the environment (DOCKER_HOST, else the local socket), unix:///path, or tcp://host:2376 with tls. ssh:// is not supported.

name.description: Name in logs, metrics and jobs[].host; unique. Default host-<index>.

JobConfig.description: A script run on its own cron schedule.

commands.description: Commands run in order; the first failure stops the job.

cron.description: Cron spec, the same syntax as schedule.cron.

host.description: Docker host for exec: commands; required with several hosts.

timezone.description: Time zone of the cron. Default: the top-level timezone.

format.description: json or text. Default json. DOCKPAUM_LOG_FORMAT overrides it.

level.description: debug, info, warn or error. Default info. DOCKPAUM_LOG_LEVEL overrides it.

NotifierConfig.description: A notification channel. With a service URL (discord://, ntfy://, smtp://, ...) or a Discord, Slack or Teams workflow webhook URL, type may be left out.

channel.description: Slack channel override, the Telegram chat id, the Pushover device(s), or the Apprise tags.

events.description: Events to deliver; * means all. Empty means update.success, update.failure and run.completed, the latter only for runs that changed, failed or found something new. The events: update.success, update.failure, update.available (dry-run, monitor-only), update.skipped (held back by a gate), update.denied (approval denied), update.rolled_back, update.recovered (an interrupted update recovered, a network reattached), check.failed (registry check failed or incomplete), self_update.started, self_update.success, self_update.failure, run.started, run.completed, dockpaum.started, dockpaum.stopping and notify.test.

header_files.description: Headers whose values are read from files, read once at startup.

name.description: Name in logs and metrics. Default: the type.

once.description: Report each standing notice (an available update in dry-run or monitor-only, a skipped or denied update, an incomplete check) once until it changes; false repeats it every run. Default true.

smtp.description: SMTP server of an email channel.

to.description: Email recipients, or the Apprise service URLs of an apprise channel.

token.description: Bot token (telegram), application token (gotify, pushover), access token (matrix) or bearer token (ntfy, webhook).

token_file.description: File holding the token, read once at startup.

type.description: Channel type; may be left out with a service URL or a well-known webhook URL.

url.description: Webhook URL, the ntfy topic URL, the Gotify or Matrix server, the Apprise API endpoint, or a service URL. Use ${VAR} or url_file.

url_file.description: File holding the URL, read once at startup.

Policy.description: An update policy. A container selects it with the label dockpaum.policy=<id>.

health_timeout.description: How long the new container has to turn healthy, else the update fails and is rolled back (rollback_on_failure); one without a healthcheck must keep running through a grace period of up to 15s. Default 2m; 0s turns the health gate off. DOCKPAUM_HEALTH_TIMEOUT sets it for the default policy.

hooks.description: Commands for containers of this policy, after the global hooks of the same phase.

id.description: Policy id, matched case-insensitively. Empty or default is the fallback for unlabelled containers; none and off are reserved. An id equal to a built-in (tag-follow, patch, minor, major, monitor) replaces it.

min_image_age.description: Skip a new image younger than this (soak time). Default 1h (the config dockpaum init writes sets 0s); 0s turns it off. DOCKPAUM_MIN_IMAGE_AGE sets it for the default policy.

min_image_age_source.description: How min_image_age is measured: auto (the image's creation time, or when dockpaum first saw the image if that time is unusable, as with reproducible builds), first_seen (from when dockpaum first saw the image, unless it was built later; needs a persistent state) or created (the creation time only). Default auto.

mode.description: tag-follow follows the digest of the current tag; patch, minor and major move to newer version tags within that range; none never checks or updates. digest is another name for tag-follow. Default tag-follow. DOCKPAUM_MODE sets it for the default policy.

monitor_only.description: Check for updates and report them (audit decision monitor-only, event update.available), never recreate. Unlike mode none, which never checks.

schedule.description: The policy's own cron spec: its containers are left out of regular runs and updated when it fires.

tags.description: Narrow (include, exclude) and reshape (transform) the version tags patch, minor and major consider.

timezone.description: Time zone of this policy's windows and schedule. Default: the top-level timezone.

windows.description: Maintenance windows: containers of this policy are updated only inside them.

PolicyHooks.description: Commands for containers of a policy.

pre_update.description: Before each update of a container of this policy.

RegistryAuth.description: Credentials for a registry, or for one repository path on it.

password.description: Password or token. Use ${VAR} or password_file.

password_file.description: File holding the password or token, read on every use so a rotated token needs no restart.

server.description: Registry host, optionally with a repository path (ghcr.io/acme) to scope the credentials.

SMTPConfig.description: SMTP server of an email channel.

password_file.description: File holding the SMTP password, read once at startup.

port.description: SMTP port, 1 to 65535. Default 587; 465 uses implicit TLS.

starttls.description: Require STARTTLS; without it, STARTTLS is used only when the server offers it.

cron.description: Cron spec: five fields ("0 4 * * *"), six with seconds first, or a descriptor such as @daily or @every 6h. A CRON_TZ=<zone> prefix overrides the time zone. Exclusive with interval.

interval.description: Run interval when no cron is set. Default 5m.

run_on_start.description: Also run once right at startup. Default: true in interval mode; in cron mode only while dry_run is on.

timezone.description: Time zone of the cron and the global windows. Default: the top-level timezone.

windows.description: Global maintenance windows: scheduled runs and policy schedules outside them do not start. Runs started through the API or with --once, and jobs, are not held back.

SelfUpdateConfig.description: How dockpaum updates its own container, through a helper container.

delay.description: How long the helper waits before replacing dockpaum. Default 5s.

enabled.description: Let dockpaum update its own container. Default false. DOCKPAUM_SELF_UPDATE overrides it.

helper_image.description: Image of the helper container. Default: the new dockpaum image.

StateConfig.description: Where dockpaum keeps its durable state.

dir.description: Directory of state.json, an absolute path; mount it as a volume to keep the state across restarts and self-updates. Default /var/lib/dockpaum/state. DOCKPAUM_STATE_DIR overrides it.

enabled.description: Keep state on disk. Default true; false keeps it in memory only.

TLS.description: TLS for a tcp:// Docker host.

insecure.description: Skip certificate verification (not recommended); verify wins when both are set.

verify.description: Verify the server certificate. Default true.

TagFilter.description: Tag rules: RE2 regular expressions over version tags, matched anywhere in the tag (anchor with ^ and $), and a transform.

exclude.description: A candidate tag must not match this.

include.description: A candidate tag must match this, when set.

transform.description: Rewrite a tag into the version that is compared: "<regex> => <template>", such as "^release-(.+)$ => $1". The template names groups as $1, ${1} or $${name} (the $$ keeps ${name} from being read as an environment variable). A tag the regex does not match is compared unchanged.

approval.description: An HTTP approval request before every update.

cleanup_images.description: Remove the old image after an update when no tag or container still uses it. DOCKPAUM_CLEANUP overrides it.

compose_group.description: Update the containers of each Compose project one after another, ordered by depends_on; strategy parallel then has no effect.

concurrency.description: Parallel updates with strategy parallel. Default 1.

anyOf.description: Map form: policy settings keyed by policy id.

policies.description: Update policies, as a list or as a mapping keyed by policy id. A container follows the policy its dockpaum.policy label names, else the default policy: a configured one, else the built-in tag-follow, patch, minor, major or monitor, which take min_image_age, health_timeout and windows from the default policy; none and off leave it alone.

restart_unchanged.description: Recreate containers even when their image did not change.

rollback_on_failure.description: Restore the old container when the new one fails to start or turn healthy. Default true. DOCKPAUM_ROLLBACK overrides it.

self_update.description: How dockpaum updates its own container.

stop_timeout.description: Graceful stop timeout of the old container; a longer stop timeout set on the container wins. Default 30s.

strategy.description: rolling (one at a time) or parallel (up to concurrency; not with compose_group). Default rolling.

WindowSpec.description: A maintenance window: days and time ranges.

days.description: Days: mon to sun, ranges such as Mon-Fri, or all, weekdays, weekends. Empty means every day.

times.description: Time ranges HH:MM-HH:MM (22:00-02:00 crosses midnight), or always. Empty means all day.

boolean.description: true or false; the YAML 1.1 spellings yes/no, on/off and y/n are accepted too.

duration.description: A duration: 30s, 5m, 1h30m, 1d or 2w (Go syntax with d and w), or whole seconds.

envRef.description: A reference to an environment variable (${VAR}, ${VAR:-default}, $VAR), expanded when the configuration loads.

description: Configuration of dockpaum, the policy-driven Docker container updater (dockpaum.yml). Values may reference environment variables as ${VAR}.

audit.description: The JSONL audit log of every update decision.

docker_config.description: Path of a Docker config.json whose inline auths are added after the registry entries, which win for the same server; credential stores and helpers are not supported. Default: config.json in $DOCKER_CONFIG when that is set.

dry_run.description: Check and report what would be updated, change nothing; jobs and pre_run/post_run hooks are skipped. Default false. DOCKPAUM_DRY_RUN overrides it; --dry-run and DOCKPAUM_WATCHTOWER_ENV=true turn it on.

hooks.description: Commands run around update runs and container updates.

hosts.description: Docker hosts. Default: one host named local, reached through the environment (DOCKER_HOST, else the local socket).

http.description: The operational HTTP server: health, readiness, busy, version, metrics and the v1 API under /internal-api/.

instance.description: Name of this dockpaum instance in notifications and status: up to 64 characters, no line breaks, tabs or control characters. Default: the host name. DOCKPAUM_INSTANCE overrides it.

jobs.description: Scripts run on their own cron schedule, independent of updates and maintenance windows; skipped while dry_run is on.

notify.description: Notification channels. DOCKPAUM_NOTIFY_URLS adds channels from service URLs; DOCKPAUM_NOTIFY_EVENTS sets the events of channels that list none.

registry.description: Registry credentials; the most specific server entry wins.

anyOf.description: Shorthand: an interval (1h, 1d) or a cron spec ("0 4 * * *").

schedule.description: When update runs happen: a mapping, or the shorthand of an interval (1h) or a cron spec ("0 4 * * *"). DOCKPAUM_SCHEDULE overrides it.

state.description: The durable state file: soak first-seen times, image defaults, notification ledger and previous images.

timezone.description: IANA time zone (Europe/Berlin) of schedules, maintenance windows, policies and jobs that set none of their own. Default: schedule.timezone, else the TZ environment variable, else UTC. DOCKPAUM_TIMEZONE overrides it.

title: dockpaum configuration
